about_the_game:
Build explosive attacks from a deck of evolving cards in this roguelike shooter about paint, chaos, and scaling destruction.

This is the free demo of Palette: Cards & Chaos, a game where you fight using a giant paintbrush. This top-down shooter blends fast-paced combat with a unique deckbuilding system: collect cards that represent brushstrokes and colors, then stack them to create powerful and unpredictable paintings of destruction.

This demo includes:

  • 6 attack cards and 11 modifier cards to experiment with

  • 5 unique enemies and 1 boss encounter

  • A single procedurally generated level

Each run is a chance to build something new. Will you decimate enemies with swift brushstrokes, or launch a storm of paint projectiles? The cards you choose define your playstyle, and the choices are endless.

Demo Features

Card-Based Combat
Stack and combine cards during each run to craft powerful attacks. Discover synergies in this self-contained demo build.

Replayable Dungeon
One level with randomized layouts, rooms, and enemies—designed for replayability.

Paint-Based Abilities
Use your brush to attack, block, and change the battlefield. Your abilities are as creative as you make them.

This is a standalone slice of the full game experience, designed to showcase Palette’s core mechanics and feel.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ (or equivalent distro)
  • Processor: Dual-core Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ (or equivalent)
  • Processor: Quad-core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 660 or better)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
